tasks.short: Prepare legal memoranda and statements of issues

steps.what: Collect and verify the actual case record, judge's assignment and relevant source authorities
inputs: Actual case documents and judge's assignment
outputs: Checked case and authority sources with unresolved gaps

steps.what: Analyze the actual legal issues and formulate the clerk's suggestions or recommendations
outputs: Clerk-authored issue analysis and recommendations

steps.what: Assemble the actual case identifiers, procedural headings and verified source-reference fields in the memo template
inputs: Verified case identifiers and actual procedural fields
outputs: Staged memo with exact factual fields and reference list

steps.what: Write the actual brief, legal memorandum or statement of issues and recommendations
inputs: Staged memo and actual case sources
outputs: Complete draft memorandum

steps.what: Check the complete final memorandum's facts, authorities, reasoning and draft status against original sources
outputs: Complete checked final internal memorandum

steps.what: Save the exact checked memorandum in the authorized internal case workspace
inputs: Exact final memorandum checked in s5
outputs: Saved internal clerk memorandum

tasks.design: Configure native {DOCS} fields for exact case identifiers and clerk-selected references from {OPS_SYSTEM} and {OTHER}. Keep legal analysis, recommendations, substantive writing and complete final checking with the clerk before saving the final internal memorandum.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated case-field and reference-list assembly adds clerical handling to legal analysis and writing.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document fields and verified reference records can populate exact administrative content without generating judicial reasoning.
tasks.still_hard: Issue selection, application of authorities and recommendations remain legal judgment.
tasks.human_edge: The clerk evaluates the actual case and develops accountable legal analysis for the judge.

ambition.what: Reduce exact factual assembly in existing internal legal writing.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-4 for court case-data and template-owner consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native document fields and reference managers can reuse verified administrative case facts and source identifiers without generating legal reasoning.

assumptions: Unmeasured internal memorandum episode with actual repeated field and reference assembly; shares are independent of the prompt prior.

Case-system owners supply actual case records; s1 counts collection and verification, s2 actual legal analysis and s4 substantive authorship. No completed reasoning, selected authorities or clean case summary is assumed free.

s3 copies only exact verified fields and selected references. Missing fields stop for manual resolution. No model chooses authority, applies law to facts or proposes a court outcome. Native reuse comes first; equivalent current templates earn no additional benefit.

s5 checks the complete final memo. s6 saves an internal clerk document only, not a signed judicial decision, court filing or message to parties. The judge's later decision is separate actual work; this saving does not remove it. Same-system saving is immediate with no saving.
Gross 15 minus 2 upkeep gives 13 net per 100 focal baseline hours.
unknowns: Court workspace access and actual manual fields
research_questions: Which identifiers and references are re-entered by hand?

already_counted.description: Retained source verification, legal analysis, substantive writing and complete final checking

incremental.description: Maintain verified field mappings and internal memo templates

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete internal memorandum checked in s5; changed facts or reasoning require renewed checking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 conditional estimate: 15 exact assembly hours removed minus 2 upkeep = 13 net. Legal analysis and substantive writing remain retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Research actual legal and case sources

steps.what: Define the actual legal research questions, relevant jurisdiction and case context
outputs: Clerk's actual source-search questions and scope

steps.what: Research laws, court decisions, opinions, briefs and documents using actual authorized source searches
inputs: OTHER: authorized legislation and case-law library
outputs: Retrieved actual source documents and source identifiers

steps.what: Read and analyze the actual authorities and documents for relevance, status and application to the research question
inputs: Research questions and actual case context
outputs: Clerk's actual source analysis and unresolved legal questions

steps.what: Capture actual research annotations and check the complete final source list, pinpoint references and source status
inputs: Original full sources and current source-status information
outputs: Complete checked research annotations and verified source list

steps.what: Save the exact checked research annotations in the authorized case workspace
inputs: Exact final research annotations checked in s4
outputs: Saved actual research record

tasks.design: Configure native jurisdiction, date and identifier searches in the authorized {OTHER} source library and {OPS_SYSTEM} case records. Keep question formulation, full-source reading, legal relevance and complete annotation checking with the clerk before saving actual research notes in {DOCS} through the authorized case workspace.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated source navigation and search filters add handling to actual legal research.
tasks.enabler_now: Native search profiles and exact identifiers can retrieve actual source records without generating answers.
tasks.still_hard: Current legal authority, context, contrary decisions and relevance require the clerk's full-source analysis.
tasks.human_edge: The clerk decides what an actual authority supports in the actual case.

ambition.what: Reduce retrieval handling in existing research.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native legal-library filters and exact source identifiers can reduce retrieval handling while full-source analysis remains manual.

assumptions: Unmeasured source-research episode with actual research annotations; shares are independent of the prompt prior.

Authorized source publishers produce source documents; s1 counts actual question formulation, s2 retrieval, s3 full reading and analysis and s4 source verification and actual note capture. No generated citation, legal summary or clean authority list is assumed free.

Native search only: no model selects binding authority or applies law to facts. Missing full text or source-status information requires manual investigation. Existing equivalent searches earn no new saving.

The saved annotations are actual research work, not a new formal memo after every lookup. No court filing or party message is hidden in the save. Same-system saving is immediate with no saving. If sources also feed task 19050, count shared research once.
Gross 8.75 minus 1.5 upkeep gives 7.25 net per 100 focal baseline hours.
unknowns: Current library filters and actual navigation effort
research_questions: Which jurisdiction and identifier filters are repeatedly entered?

incremental.description: Maintain authorized search profiles and check source-library changes

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete research annotations checked in s4; changed sources or claims require renewed checking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 conditional estimate: 25 times 35% = 8.75 gross retrieval reduction, minus 1.5 upkeep = 7.25 net. Full reading and legal analysis remain retained.

tasks.short: Draft or proofread judicial opinions and citations

steps.what: Read the actual judge's instructions, case record and selected authorities for the requested draft opinion
outputs: Checked drafting context and actual source set

steps.what: Develop the actual legal analysis and proposed reasoning within the judge's assignment
outputs: Clerk-authored proposed reasoning for the draft

steps.what: Assemble exact verified case headings, procedural fields and selected reference records in the actual opinion template
inputs: Court's actual draft template and citation style
outputs: Staged draft with administrative fields and formatted actual reference list

steps.what: Draft the actual opinion text and proofread its legal reasoning and citations against original sources
outputs: Complete draft judicial opinion for the judge

steps.what: Check the complete final draft, citations, proposed reasoning, confidentiality and actual judge recipient
outputs: Exact complete checked internal draft and judge recipient

steps.what: Send the exact checked internal draft to the actual judge through the authorized court workspace
inputs: Exact draft and judge recipient checked in s5
outputs: Judge receives the internal draft for actual judicial review

tasks.design: Configure native {DOCS} assembly of exact case fields from {OPS_SYSTEM} and selected citation records from {OTHER}. Keep all substantive reasoning, draft writing and proofreading with the clerk, who checks the complete final internal draft before separately sending it to the judge.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated administrative fields and reference formatting add clerical work to judicial drafting.
tasks.enabler_now: Native court templates and verified reference records can assemble exact administrative content without generating reasoning.
tasks.still_hard: Actual legal reasoning, citation support and the judge's final decision remain legal work.
tasks.human_edge: The clerk checks the actual case and sources; the judge retains actual judicial authority.

ambition.what: Reduce exact field and formatting work in actual opinion drafts.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-4 for court-template and confidential-case access consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: court document templates and reference styles can assemble verified administrative fields and actual citations without drafting legal reasoning.

assumptions: Unmeasured draft-opinion episode, not a universal mix of drafting and standalone proofreading. Shares are independent of the prompt prior.

s1 counts actual source and instruction reading; s2 develops actual proposed reasoning and s4 writes and proofreads the substantive draft. No finished legal reasoning or verified authority list is assumed free.

s3 only assembles exact fields and formats actual clerk-selected references. Missing facts remain unresolved for manual correction. No model applies law to facts, chooses an outcome or writes judicial reasoning. Existing equivalent native assembly earns no extra gain.

s5 checks the complete final draft and recipient. s6 sends an internal draft only, not a signed judgment, filing, public release or order. The judge's review occurs after the complete draft exists and is separate actual judicial work, not removed by this proposal. Changed content or recipient voids the clerk's send gate.
The immediate internal send earns no saving. Shared case research with tasks 19050 and 19051 is counted once. Gross 20 minus 3 upkeep gives 17 net per 100 focal baseline hours.
unknowns: Current template fields and reference formatting
research_questions: Which administrative fields are still manually copied into draft opinions?

incremental.description: Maintain court field mappings and citation styles and test changed templates

approvals.approved_version: Exact complete internal draft and judge recipient checked in s5; changed text or destination requires renewed checking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 conditional estimate: 20 exact administrative assembly hours removed minus 3 upkeep = 17 net. Legal reasoning, substantive writing, citation verification and judicial review remain retained.

tasks.short: Confer with judges on legal questions and documents

steps.what: Retrieve and check the actual case documents, pending legal question and current working draft before conferring
inputs: Actual judge's question and relevant current documents
outputs: Checked current context for the judicial discussion

steps.what: Confer with the judge concerning actual legal questions, document construction or possible granting of orders
inputs: Actual judge's questions and clerk's analysis
outputs: Actual legal discussion and judge's drafting instructions or unresolved questions

steps.what: Capture the actual drafting instructions in the current working note and check the complete final entry
outputs: Complete checked working-note revision

steps.what: Save the exact checked working-note revision in the authorized case workspace
inputs: Exact final working note checked in s3
outputs: Saved actual drafting instructions

tasks.design: Configure native {OPS_SYSTEM} current-case views and the existing {DOCS} working-note headings. Keep the actual legal discussion and instruction capture with the clerk, then save the complete checked final working-note revision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the current document and repeating instruction-note structure adds handling around judicial discussion.
tasks.enabler_now: Native current-document views and note headings can reuse actual case context.
tasks.still_hard: Legal questions, document meaning and actual judicial decisions require the judge and clerk.
tasks.human_edge: The clerk understands the judge's instructions and can clarify actual legal disagreements.

ambition.what: Reduce handling around actual judicial consultation.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: current-case document views and native working-note headings can reduce retrieval and repeated note structure without resolving legal questions.

assumptions: Unmeasured discussion episode with an actual working-note revision for drafting instructions, not a formal report after every conversation. Shares are independent of the prompt prior.

The actual case workspace and judge supply context; s1 counts retrieval and checking, s2 actual conferring and s3 instruction capture and complete final checking. No complete legal answer or transcript is assumed free.
No model interprets instructions or decides legal questions. Native forms come first and existing equivalent views earn no new benefit.

The note is not an order, judgment, court filing or external message. Actual order drafting and judicial authorization, if required, occur separately on the final document. Same-system save is immediate with no saving. Shared draft work is counted once across these tasks.
Gross 4.9 minus 1 upkeep gives 3.9 net per 100 focal baseline hours.
